adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds a new token refresh flow that always executes a `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` using the stored `refresh_token`, then persists the new token via `prisma.credential.update(...)` before creating the jsforce connection. Unlike other integrations changed in this PR, this path does **not** use the new `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` helper, so it will never route through `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` when app credential sharing is enabled. The “unconditional eager refresh on every connection” and “bypasses refreshOAuthTokens” parts are directly verifiable; claims about overwriting “parent-app-synced tokens” are more speculative, but the inconsistency with the new sync/refresh abstraction is a concrete, diff-grounded review concern.
